notes: v2.9.72 GABOJA: Young-Cha-Young2 is now price-structure led instead of being classified by a high-volume-drop subtype. Young1 can be a rising candle or rising hill without requiring that individual candle volume expand. A 65% deep Cha is tracked as a structural pullback regardless of pullback volume, so slow low-volume drifts and other pullbacks remain under observation. The existing direct-Cha buy keeps the volume-pace slowdown safeguard, while the second entry path keeps tracking the structure and buys only when a bullish candle body crosses the Young1 prior high; wick-only breaks remain rejected. Young2 entry uses the confirmed pullback low as its stop. Other auto-trading, account-header, Watermelon and Concrete rules remain unchanged.
